rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: GitHub Private enables authenticated access to private GitHub repositories and organizational resources through OAuth credentials. It extends standard GitHub tooling to include private repos, org-level data, issues, and pull requests not accessible with read-only tokens. Requires a user-provided GitHub OAuth token via the Pipeworx gateway.
